subject: Ember thermostat keeps dropping off Wi-Fi
body: I've tried setting up my Ember thermostat three times and it never gets past the Wi-Fi step. The app just says 'connection failed'. My phone is on the same 2.4 GHz network.
reply: Thanks for the details. Wi-Fi drops on the Ember thermostat are almost always a 2.4 GHz band-steering issue with mesh routers. Please try these steps: (1) In your router app, create a dedicated 2.4 GHz network or temporarily disable band steering. (2) Hold the reset button on the Ember thermostat for 10 seconds until the light blinks amber. (3) Set it up again in the app on that 2.4 GHz network. If it still drops after 24 hours, reply with your router model and we will escalate to our network team.

reply: Thanks for the details. Wi-Fi drops on the Sentry doorbell are almost always a 2.4 GHz band-steering issue with mesh routers. Please try these steps: (1) In your router app, create a dedicated 2.4 GHz network or temporarily disable band steering. (2) Hold the reset button on the Sentry doorbell for 10 seconds until the light blinks amber. (3) Set it up again in the app on that 2.4 GHz network. If it still drops after 24 hours, reply with your router model and we will escalate to our network team.

reply: Thanks for the details, and sorry for the dropouts. A Lumen bulb pack that keeps leaving the network is usually fighting with band steering on a mesh router. reply: Thanks for the details, and sorry for the dropouts. A Sentry doorbell that keeps leaving the network is usually fighting with band steering on a mesh router. Try this: (1) Give your 2.4 GHz band its own network name in the router app, or switch band steering off for now. (2) Press and hold the reset button on the Sentry doorbell for 10 seconds, until the light flashes amber. (3) Pair it again in the app, this time on the 2.4 GHz network. Still dropping a day later? Send us your router model and we will pass it to our network team.

Please try these steps: (1) In your router app, create a dedicated 2.4 GHz network or temporarily disable band steering. (2) Hold the reset button on the Ember thermostat for 10 seconds until the light blinks amber. (3) Set it up again in the app on that 2.4 GHz network. If it still drops after 24 hours, reply with your router model and we will escalate to our network team.

subject: Unexpected charge on my card
body: I see a charge from you that I don't recognize. I only bought a Ember thermostat last month and that was already paid.
reply: Sorry for the worry over your Ember thermostat charge. I checked the order on our side. When a payment is first authorized and then captured, some banks list both as pending charges for 2 to 3 business days until the authorization drops off. If you still see both after 3 business days, reply with the last four digits of the card and your order number, and we will refund the duplicate within one business day. You will only ever pay once for the Ember thermostat.

subject: Broken Breeze air purifier in the box
body: The box for my Breeze air purifier arrived crushed on one corner and the device has a crack across the front. Haven't tried powering it on.
reply: I'm sorry your Breeze air purifier showed up damaged. A replacement is on us. Reply with a photo of the damage and one of the shipping label, and we will file the carrier claim ourselves. When we have those, we ship you a replacement Breeze air purifier along with a prepaid return label for the damaged unit, and you do not have to wait for the return to arrive first. Turnaround is typically 2 business days.

subject: App won't show my Ember thermostat
body: The app crashes every time I tap on my Ember thermostat. Reinstalling didn't help. iPhone, latest iOS.
reply: Sorry about the trouble, and thank you for reporting it. We know about a sync problem in the latest app release that can make a Ember thermostat disappear or look offline. The fix ships in version 4.12.2, which is rolling out now. For now, sign out, force close the app, sign in again, and pull down on the device list to refresh, which re-syncs the Ember thermostat for most people. If it is still missing once you are on 4.12.2, reply with your account email and we will re-link the device for you.
